description_sq:
Ne yzberisht prane pasticeri Nela 6 shitet apartament 180 m2 bruto dhe 164 m2 neto. Apartamenti eshte ne katin e pare banim dhe nuk eshte i rregulluar . E pershtatshme per tu ndare ne 2 apartamente 2+1 secila. Mundesia eshte qe te ndahet edhe ne te pakten 3 apartamente 1+1. Apartamenti eshte me dokumentacion te rregullt pronesie e cila mund te lihet edhe kolateral ne banke. Eshte nje mundesi shume e mire investimi dhe jetese. Zona eshte me markete bare dhe restorante.
Per nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
description_en: An apartment of 180 m2 gross and 164 m2 net is for sale in Yzberisht, near the pastry shop Nela 6. The apartment is on the first residential floor and is not furnished. Suitable for dividing into 2 apartments 2+1 each. It is possible to divide it into at least 3 apartments 1+1. The apartment has regular ownership documentation, which can also be left as collateral in the bank. It is a very good investment and living opportunity. The area has markets, bars and restaurants. For a visit to the property, contact us!
